24: #define IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION 2u

29: static mutex_t g_ipc_lock = NXMUTEX_INITIALIZER;

31: static volatile int g_ipc_ack_result;

35: static int bind_worker_to_primary(void)
36: {
37: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
38:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
39: 
40:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
41:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
42:   return sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
43: #else
44:   return OK;
45: #endif
46: }

48: static void ipc_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
49:                             int result, void *arg)
50: {
51:   (void)arg;
52:   if (result == OK &&
53:       (ack == NULL || ack->reserved != IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE))
54:     {
55:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
56:     }
57: 
58:   g_ipc_ack_result = result;
59: }
60: 
61: static int ipc_send(uint8_t command, uint32_t parameter)
62: {
63:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
64:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
65:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
66:   int ret;
67: 
68:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_ipc_lock);
69:   if (ret < 0)
70:     {
71:       return ret;
72:     }
73: 
74:   *payload = parameter;
75:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
76: 
77:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
78:   message.header = command;
79:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
80:   message.payload_length =
81:     command == IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ? sizeof(*payload) : 0;
82:   g_ipc_ack_result = -EINPROGRESS;
83: 
84:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
85:                                  ipc_tx_complete, NULL);
86:   if (ret == OK)
87:     {
88:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
89:       if (ret == OK)
90:         {
91:           ret = g_ipc_ack_result;
92:         }
93:     }
94: 
95:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_ipc_lock);
96:   return ret > 0 ? -EIO : ret;
97: }

99: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
100: {
101:   uint32_t failures = 0;
102:   int ret;
103: 
104:   (void)argc;
105:   (void)argv;
106: 
107:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
108:   if (ret >= 0)
109:     {
110:       ret = ipc_send(IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION, 0);
111:     }
112: 
113:   g_ipc_start_result = ret < 0 ? ret : OK;
114:   nxsem_post(&g_ipc_start_sem);
115:   if (ret < 0)
116:     {
117:       return ret;
118:     }
119: 
120:   for (;;)
121:     {
122:       nxsig_usleep(IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_US);
123:       ret = ipc_send(IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION, 0);
124:       if (ret < 0)
125:         {
126:           failures++;
127:           if ((failures & (failures - 1u)) == 0)
128:             {
129:               syslog(LOG_ERR, "IPC heartbeat send failed: %d count=%lu\n",
130:                      ret, (unsigned long)failures);
131:             }
132:         }
133:     }
134: 
135:   return OK;
136: }
137: 
138: int bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_start(void)
139: {
140:   int pid;
141:   int ret;
142: 
143:   if (g_ipc_started)
144:     {
145:       return g_ipc_start_result;
146:     }
147: 
148:   nxsem_init(&g_ipc_start_sem, 0, 0);
149:   g_ipc_start_result = -EINPROGRESS;
150:   pid = kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536,
151:                        ipc_heartbeat_worker, NULL);
152:   if (pid < 0)
153:     {
154:       return pid;
155:     }
156: 
157:   g_ipc_started = true;
158:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_ipc_start_sem, MSEC2TICK(1000));
159:   if (ret < 0)
160:     {
161:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
162:     }
163: 
164:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
165:     {
166:       printf("IPC: HW_CTRL power-up acknowledged by CP\n");
167:     }
168: 
169:   return g_ipc_start_result;
170: }

530:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)

536:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
537:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
538:             g_channel_ids[i]);
539:         }
540: 
541:       active->callback = channel->callback;
542:       active->arg = channel->arg;
543:       active->channel_index = i;
544:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
545:       active->busy = true;
546:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
547:       if (ret < 0)
548:         {
549:           active->busy = false;
550:           return ret;
551:         }
552: 
553:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
554:         {
555:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
556:             {
557:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
558:             }
559: 
560:           g_probe_attempts++;
561:           g_stats.probes++;
562:         }
563: 
564:       return OK;
565:     }
566: 
567:   return OK;
568: }

570: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
571:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
572:   const struct active_transaction *active)
573: {
574:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
575:   uint32_t reason = 0;
576: 
577:   if (!active->busy)
578:     {
579:       return 1u;
580:     }
581: 
582:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
583:     {
584:       reason |= 2u;
585:     }
586:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
587:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
588:     {
589:       reason |= 4u;
590:     }
591:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
592:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
593:     {
594:       reason |= 8u;
595:     }
596:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
597:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
598:     {
599:       reason |= 16u;
600:     }
601: 
602:   return reason;
603: }
604: 
605: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
606: {
607:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
608:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
609:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
610: }
611: 
612: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
613: {
614:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
615:   struct active_transaction *active;
616:   bool replay;
617:   int result;
618:   uint32_t reason;
619: 
620: 
621:   active = busy_probe();
622:   if (active == NULL)
623:     {
624:       active = &g_active;
625:     }
626: 
627:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
628:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
629:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
630:   if (reason != 0)
631:     {
632:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
633:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
634:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
635:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
636:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
637:       return;
638:     }
639: 
640: 
641:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
642:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
643:     {
644:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
645: 
646:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
647:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
648:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
649:       return;
650:     }
651: 
652:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
653:     {
654:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
655:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
656:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
657:       return;
658:     }
659: 
660:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
661:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
662: 
663:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
664:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
665:     {
666:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
667:     }
668: 
669:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
670:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
671:   if (replay)
672:     {
673:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
674:       unsigned int i;
675: 
676:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
677:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
678:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
679:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
680:        */
681: 
682:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
683:       g_active.quarantine = false;
684:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
685:         {
686:           if (i != replay_index)
687:             {
688:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
689:             }
690:         }
691: 
692:       select_recovery_epoch();
693:       (void)dispatch_locked();
694:       return;
695:     }
696: 
697:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
698: 
699:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
700:     {
701:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
702:         {
703:           release_recovery_slots();
704:           g_recovery_index = 0;
705:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
706:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
707:         }
708:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
709:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
710:         {
711:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
712:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
713:            */
714:         }
715:       else
716:         {
717:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
718:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
719:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
720:         }
721:     }
722: 
723:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
724:            result < 0)
725:     {
726:       begin_abort(result);
727:     }
728: 
729:   (void)dispatch_locked();
730: }
731: 
732: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
733: {
734:   struct ack_slot *slot;
735:   unsigned int rx_index;
736:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
737:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
738:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
739:   uint8_t state = 0;
740:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
741: 
742:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
743: 
744:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
745:     {
746:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
747:       if (slot == NULL)
748:         {
749:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
750:           return -EAGAIN;
751:         }
752:     }
753:   else
754:     {
755:       slot = NULL;
756:     }
757: 
758:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
759:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
760:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
761:     {
762:       g_stats.bad_header++;
763:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
764:     }
765:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
766:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
767:     {
768:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
769:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
770:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
771:         {
772:           if (slot != NULL)
773:             {
774:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
775:             }
776: 
777:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
778:           return -EAGAIN;
779:         }
780:       else if (ret < 0)
781:         {
782:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
783:         }
784:     }
785:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
786:     {
787:       g_pwc_rx(message);
788:       ret = OK;
789:     }
790:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
791:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
792:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
793:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
794:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
795:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
796:     {
797:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
798:       ack_flags = 2u;
799:       ret = OK;
800:     }
801:   else
802:     {
803:       g_stats.unsupported++;
804:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
805:     }
806: 
807:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
808:     {
809:       return OK;
810:     }
811: 
812:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
813:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
814:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
815:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
816:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
817: 
818:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
819:     {
820:       g_probe_requested = true;
821:     }
822: 
823:   (void)dispatch_locked();
824:   return OK;
825: }
826: 
827: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
828: {
829:   irqstate_t flags;
830:   uint8_t control;
831: 
832:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
833:   g_stats.rx++;
834:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
835: 
836:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
837:     {
838:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
839:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
840:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
841:         {
842:           g_stats.bad_header++;
843:         }
844:       else
845:         {
846:           g_stats.resets++;
847:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
848:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
849:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
850:         }
851:     }
852:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
853:     {
854:       handle_ack(message);
855:     }
856:   else
857:     {
858:       int ret = handle_command(message);
859: 
860:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
861:         {
862:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
863:           return ret;
864:         }
865:     }
866: 
867:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
868:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
869:   return OK;
870: }

872: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
873: {
874:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
875:   int ret;
876: 
877:   (void)argc;
878:   (void)argv;
879:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
880:   g_diag_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
881:   nxsem_post(&g_diag_worker_ready_sem);
882:   if (ret < 0)
883:     {
884:       return -EXDEV;
885:     }
886: 
887:   for (;;)
888:     {
889:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
890:       irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
891:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
892:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
893:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
894:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
895:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
896:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
897: 
898:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
899:       if (reported == state)
900:         {
901:           continue;
902:         }
903: 
904:       reported = state;
905:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
906:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
907:         {
908:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
909:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
910:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
911:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
912:         }
913: 
914:       if (callback != NULL)
915:         {
916:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
917:         }
918:     }
919: 
920:   return OK;
921: }

923: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
924: {
925:   int ret;
926: 
927:   (void)argc;
928:   (void)argv;
929:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
930:   g_tx_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
931:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_worker_ready_sem);
932:   if (ret < 0)
933:     {
934:       return -EXDEV;
935:     }
936: 
937:   for (;;)
938:     {
939:       struct active_transaction *probe;
940:       irqstate_t flags;
941:       bool request_probe;
942: 
943:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
944:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
945: 
946:       probe = busy_probe();
947:       if ((g_active.busy &&
948:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
949:           (probe != NULL &&
950:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
951:         {
952:           g_stats.timeout++;
953:           bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
954:             (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
955:             ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
956:             ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
957:             ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
958:           if (probe != NULL)
959:             {
960:               probe->quarantine = true;
961:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
962:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
963:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
964:             }
965:           else
966:             {
967:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
968:             }
969:         }
970: 
971:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
972:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
973:         {
974:           select_recovery_epoch();
975:         }
976: 
977:       (void)dispatch_locked();
978:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
979:         {
980:           g_probe_requested = false;
981:         }
982: 
983:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
984:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
985:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
986:       if (request_probe)
987:         {
988:           g_probe_requested = false;
989:         }
990: 
991:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
992: 
993:       if (request_probe)
994:         {
995:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
996:         }
997:     }
998: 
999:   return OK;
1000: }

1121: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
1122:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1123:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
1124: {
1125:   struct logical_channel *channel;
1126:   unsigned int index;
1127:   irqstate_t flags;
1128:   int ret;
1129: 
1130:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
1131:     {
1132:       return -EAGAIN;
1133:     }
1134: 
1135:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1136:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1137:     {
1138:       return -EINVAL;
1139:     }
1140: 
1141:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1142:   channel = &g_channels[index];
1143:   if (channel->queued)
1144:     {
1145:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1146:       return -EBUSY;
1147:     }
1148: 
1149:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1150:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
1151:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
1152:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
1153:     {
1154:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1155:       return -ENOLINK;
1156:     }
1157: 
1158:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
1159:     {
1160:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1161:       return -ENOLINK;
1162:     }
1163: 
1164:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
1165:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
1166:   channel->callback = callback;
1167:   channel->arg = arg;
1168:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
1169:   channel->queued = true;
1170:   ret = dispatch_locked();
1171:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)
1172:     {
1173:       channel->queued = false;
1174:       channel->result = ret;
1175:     }
1176: 
1177:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1178:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1179:   return ret;
1180: }

314:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;

322:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
323:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
324:   g_queue[g_head] = message;

360:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
361:               {
362:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
363:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;

397:                            "error=%d\n", ret);

404:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();

408:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:

412:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:

414: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP

416:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
417:                       (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
418: #else

422:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
423:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
424:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,

431:             }
432:             break;
433: #endif
434: 
435:           default:
436:             break;
437:         }
438:     }

43:     ((g_stats.bad_length & 0xffu) << 8) |
44:     ((g_stats.bad_address & 0xffu) << 16) |
45:     ((g_stats.descriptor_full & 0xffu) << 24));

53:   return getreg32(up_cpu_index() == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
54:                                        BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS);

57: static void mbox_clear_errors(int cpu)
58: {
59:   uintptr_t cfg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG;
60:   uint32_t config = getreg32(cfg);
61:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
62: 
63:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
64:     {
65:       g_stats.write_error++;
66:     }
67: 
68:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
69:     {
70:       g_stats.read_error++;
71:     }
72: 
73:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
74:     {
75:       g_stats.write_full++;
76:     }
77: 
78:   if (errors != 0)
79:     {
80:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, cfg);
81:     }

84: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
85:                                 uint32_t length)
86: {
87:   if (source != 0)
88:     {
89:       g_stats.bad_source++;
90:       mbox_trace_errors();
91:       return false;
92:     }
93: 
94:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
95:     {
96:       g_stats.bad_length++;
97:       mbox_trace_errors();
98:       return false;
99:     }
100: 
101:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
102:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
103:     {
104:       g_stats.bad_address++;

112: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
113: {
114:   uintptr_t status;
115:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
116: 
117:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
118:     {
119:       return -EINVAL;

122: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
123:   if (cpu == 1 && (destination != 1 || data[1] != 0))
124:     {
125:       return -EPERM;
126:     }
127: #endif

129:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
130:    * receive FIFO status register.

132: 
133:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
134:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
135:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
136:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
137:     {
138:       return -EAGAIN;
139:     }

142:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
143:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
144:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);

152:   unsigned int i;
153: 
154:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)

165: static bool mbox_priority_message(
166:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
167: {
168:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
169: 
170:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
171: }

173: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
174: {
175:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
176:   unsigned int i;
177: 
178:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
179:     {
180:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
181: 
182:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
183:         {
184:           continue;
185:         }
186: 
187:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
188:         {
189:           oldest = desc;
190:         }
191:     }
192: 
193:   return oldest;
194: }

196: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
197: {
198:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
199:   int ret;
200: 
201:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
202:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
203:    */
204: 
205:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
206:     {
207:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
208:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
209:       g_processing_order = 0;
210:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:         {
212:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
213:           break;
214:         }
215: 
216:       desc->used = false;
217:     }
218: 
219:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
220:     {
221:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
222:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
223:       g_processing_order = 0;
224:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
225:         {
226:           break;
227:         }
228: 
229:       desc->used = false;
230:     }
231: }

233: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
234: {
235:   uintptr_t rdata0;
236:   uintptr_t rdata1;
237:   uintptr_t sidreg;
238:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
239:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
240: 
241:   (void)irq;
242:   (void)context;
243:   (void)arg;
244: 
245:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
246:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
247:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
248:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
249:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
250:     {
251:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
252:     }
253:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
254:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
255:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
256: 
257:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
258:     {
259:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
260:       uint32_t address;
261:       uint32_t length;
262:       uint8_t source;
263: 
264:       if (cpu == 0)
265:         {
266:           mbox_process_desc();
267:         }
268: 
269:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
270:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
271:         {
272:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
273:           mbox_trace_errors();
274:           break;
275:         }
276: 
277:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
278:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
279:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
280: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
281:       if (length == 0)
282:         {
283:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
284:             {
285:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
286:                 {
287:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
288:                 }
289: 
290:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
291:             }
292:           else
293:             {
294:               if (cpu == 0)
295:                 {
296:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
297:                   mbox_trace_errors();
298:                 }
299:             }
300: 
301:           continue;
302:         }
303: #endif
304: 
305:       if (cpu != 0)
306:         {
307:           continue;
308:         }
309: 
310:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
311:         {
312:           continue;
313:         }
314: 
315:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
316:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
317:              sizeof(desc->message));
318:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
319:       desc->used = true;
320:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
321:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, desc->message.header);
322:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, address);
323:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.rx_messages);
324:       mbox_process_desc();
325:     }
326: 
327:   if (cpu == 0)
328:     {
329:       mbox_process_desc();
330:     }
331: 
332:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
333:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
334:     {
335:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
336:     }
337: 
338:   return OK;
339: }

383: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
384: {
385:   int ret;
386: 
387:   if (g_mbox_ready)
388:     {
389:       return OK;
390:     }

392:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));

394:   g_processing_order = 0;

397:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
398:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
399:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
400:    */
401: 
402:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
403:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
404:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
405:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
406: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
407:   putreg32(5u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
408:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
409:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);
410:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH2_FIFO_CFG);
411: #endif
412:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
413:   mbox_clear_errors(0);
414: 
415:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
416:   if (ret < 0)
417:     {
418:       return ret;
419:     }
420: 
421:   g_mbox_ready = true;
422: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
423:   g_mbox_smp_ready = true;
424: #endif
425:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
426:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
427:   return OK;

440: int bk7258_mbox_secondary_init(void)

444:       return -EAGAIN;

1: #!/bin/sh
2: 
3: set -eu
4: 
5: script_dir=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")
6: csv=${1:-$script_dir/../../../../external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv}
7: generated=${2:-${BK7258_ARMINO_RAM_HEADER:-}}
8: header=$script_dir/hardware/bk7258_mbox.h
9: linker=$script_dir/../../boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/scripts/ld.script
10: 
11: if [ ! -r "$csv" ]; then
12:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout: cannot read $csv" >&2
13:   exit 1
14: fi
15: 
16: result=$(awk -F, '
17:   function hex(value, result, i, digit) {
18:     sub(/^0[xX]/, "", value)
19:     value = tolower(value)
20:     result = 0
21:     for (i = 1; i <= length(value); i++) {
22:       digit = index("0123456789abcdef", substr(value, i, 1)) - 1
23:       if (digit < 0) return -1
24:       result = result * 16 + digit
25:     }
26:     return result
27:   }
28:   BEGIN { base = hex("28000000"); found = 0 }
29:   /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
30:   /^[[:space:]]*PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE/ { next }
31:   NF >= 4 {
32:     name = $1
33:     type = $2
34:     offset = $3
35:     size = $4
36:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", name)
37:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", type)
38:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", offset)
39:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", size)
40:     if (type != "SRAM") next
41:     if (offset != "") base = hex(offset)
42:     bytes = hex(size)
43:     if (name == "SWAP") {
44:       printf "0x%08x 0x%08x\n", base, bytes
45:       found = 1
46:     }
47:     base += bytes
48:   }
49:   END { if (!found) exit 2 }
50: ' "$csv")
51: 
52: header_result=$(awk '
53:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_SWAP_BASE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); base=tolower($3) }
54:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_SWAP_SIZE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); size=tolower($3) }
55:   END { print base, size }
56: ' "$header")
57: 
58: if [ "$header_result" != "$result" ]; then
59:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 header SWAP mismatch: CSV=$result header=$header_result" >&2
60:   exit 1
61: fi
62: 
63: uart_result=$(awk '
64:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); rx=tolower($3) }
65:   /#define[[:space:]]+BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); tx=tolower($3) }
66:   END { print rx, tx }
67: ' "$header")
68: expected_uart=$(awk -v layout="$result" '
69:   function hex(value, result, i, digit) {
70:     sub(/^0[xX]/, "", value)
71:     value = tolower(value)
72:     result = 0
73:     for (i = 1; i <= length(value); i++) {
74:       digit = index("0123456789abcdef", substr(value, i, 1)) - 1
75:       if (digit < 0) return -1
76:       result = result * 16 + digit
77:     }
78:     return result
79:   }
80:   BEGIN {
81:     split(layout, fields, " ")
82:     base = hex(fields[1])
83:     printf "0x%08x 0x%08x\n", base + 1024, base + 1280
84:   }
85: ')
86: if [ "$uart_result" != "$expected_uart" ]; then
87:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 UART0 SWAP mismatch: expected=$expected_uart header=$uart_result" >&2
88:   exit 1
89: fi
90: 
91: linker_result=$(awk '
92:   /SWAP[[:space:]]+\(rw\)/ {
93:     for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) {
94:       if ($i == "ORIGIN") base=$(i + 2)
95:       if ($i == "LENGTH") size=$(i + 2)
96:     }
97:     gsub(/,/, "", base)
98:     print tolower(base), tolower(size)
99:   }
100: ' "$linker")
101: 
102: if [ "$linker_result" != "$result" ]; then
103:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 linker SWAP mismatch: CSV=$result linker=$linker_result" >&2
104:   exit 1
105: fi
106: 
107: if [ -n "$generated" ]; then
108:   if [ ! -r "$generated" ]; then
109:     printf '%s\n' "BK7258 generated RAM header unreadable: $generated" >&2
110:     exit 1
111:   fi
112: 
113:   generated_result=$(awk '
114:     /#define[[:space:]]+CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); base=tolower($3) }
115:     /#define[[:space:]]+CONFIG_SWAP_SIZE/ { gsub(/[uUlL]/, "", $3); size=tolower($3) }
116:     END { print base, size }
117:   ' "$generated")
118:   if [ "$generated_result" != "$result" ]; then
119:     printf '%s\n' "BK7258 generated RAM header mismatch: CSV=$result generated=$generated_result" >&2
120:     exit 1
121:   fi
122: fi

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 Armino-compatible HW_CTRL power-up and heartbeat service.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <stdio.h>
11: #include <string.h>
12: #include <syslog.h>
13: 
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
16: #include <nuttx/mutex.h>
17: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
18: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
19: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
20: 
21: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
22: 
23: #define IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION   1u
24: #define IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION 2u
25: #define IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE         2u
26: #define IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS        600u
27: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_US      2000000u
28: 
29: static mutex_t g_ipc_lock = NXMUTEX_INITIALIZER;
30: static sem_t g_ipc_start_sem;
31: static volatile int g_ipc_ack_result;
32: static volatile int g_ipc_start_result;
33: static bool g_ipc_started;
34: 
35: static int bind_worker_to_primary(void)
36: {
37: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
38:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
39: 
40:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
41:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
42:   return sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
43: #else
44:   return OK;
45: #endif
46: }
47: 
48: static void ipc_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
49:                             int result, void *arg)
50: {
51:   (void)arg;
52:   if (result == OK &&
53:       (ack == NULL || ack->reserved != IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE))
54:     {
55:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
56:     }
57: 
58:   g_ipc_ack_result = result;
59: }
60: 
61: static int ipc_send(uint8_t command, uint32_t parameter)
62: {
63:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
64:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
65:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
66:   int ret;
67: 
68:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_ipc_lock);
69:   if (ret < 0)
70:     {
71:       return ret;
72:     }
73: 
74:   *payload = parameter;
75:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
76: 
77:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
78:   message.header = command;
79:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
80:   message.payload_length =
81:     command == IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ? sizeof(*payload) : 0;
82:   g_ipc_ack_result = -EINPROGRESS;
83: 
84:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
85:                                  ipc_tx_complete, NULL);
86:   if (ret == OK)
87:     {
88:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
89:       if (ret == OK)
90:         {
91:           ret = g_ipc_ack_result;
92:         }
93:     }
94: 
95:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_ipc_lock);
96:   return ret > 0 ? -EIO : ret;
97: }
98: 
99: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
100: {
101:   uint32_t failures = 0;
102:   int ret;
103: 
104:   (void)argc;
105:   (void)argv;
106: 
107:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
108:   if (ret >= 0)
109:     {
110:       ret = ipc_send(IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION, 0);
111:     }
112: 
113:   g_ipc_start_result = ret < 0 ? ret : OK;
114:   nxsem_post(&g_ipc_start_sem);
115:   if (ret < 0)
116:     {
117:       return ret;
118:     }
119: 
120:   for (;;)
121:     {
122:       nxsig_usleep(IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_US);
123:       ret = ipc_send(IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION, 0);
124:       if (ret < 0)
125:         {
126:           failures++;
127:           if ((failures & (failures - 1u)) == 0)
128:             {
129:               syslog(LOG_ERR, "IPC heartbeat send failed: %d count=%lu\n",
130:                      ret, (unsigned long)failures);
131:             }
132:         }
133:     }
134: 
135:   return OK;
136: }
137: 
138: int bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_start(void)
139: {
140:   int pid;
141:   int ret;
142: 
143:   if (g_ipc_started)
144:     {
145:       return g_ipc_start_result;
146:     }
147: 
148:   nxsem_init(&g_ipc_start_sem, 0, 0);
149:   g_ipc_start_result = -EINPROGRESS;
150:   pid = kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536,
151:                        ipc_heartbeat_worker, NULL);
152:   if (pid < 0)
153:     {
154:       return pid;
155:     }
156: 
157:   g_ipc_started = true;
158:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_ipc_start_sem, MSEC2TICK(1000));
159:   if (ret < 0)
160:     {
161:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
162:     }
163: 
164:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
165:     {
166:       printf("IPC: HW_CTRL power-up acknowledged by CP\n");
167:     }
168: 
169:   return g_ipc_start_result;
170: }

184: bk7258_mb_header_seq(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
185: {

187:          BK7258_MB_HEADER_SEQ_SHIFT;

191: bk7258_mb_header_channel(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)

198:                                              uint8_t control, uint8_t sequence,
199:                                              uint8_t channel)

27: #define CHNL_STATE_BUSY		1
28: #define CHNL_STATE_IDLE		0

30: /* If a physical channel stays BUSY longer than this (in milliseconds)
31:  * without seeing the matching ACK from the peer CPU, mb_chnl_write() will
32:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
33:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
34:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
35: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200
36: #define MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN			8
37: #define MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND		1

53: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
54: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */

214: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
215: {
216: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
217: 
218: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
219: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
220: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
221: 
222: 	return ret_code;
223: }

225: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
226: {
227: 	/* Keep one ACK slot available for the command currently being handled.
228: 	 * A command must not be consumed and its business callback run if its
229: 	 * transport ACK cannot be queued. */
230: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1;
231: }
232: 
233: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
234: {
235: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
236: 
237: 	while (1)
238: 	{
239: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
240: 		bk_err_t ret;
241: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
242: 
243: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
244: 		{
245: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
246: 			return;
247: 		}
248: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
249: 		ack_sending = 1;
250: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
251: 
252: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
253: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
254: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
255: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
256: 		{
257: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
258: 			ack_sending = 0;
259: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
260: 			return;
261: 		}
262: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
263: 		ack_count--;
264: 		ack_sending = 0;
265: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
266: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
267: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
268: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
269: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
270: 	}
271: }
272: 
273: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
274: {
275: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
276: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
277: 
278: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1)
279: 	{
280: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
281: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 		return false;
283: 	}
284: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
285: 	entry->data = *data;
286: 	entry->destination = destination;
287: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
288: 	ack_count++;
289: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
290: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
291: 	return true;
292: }

306: static void mb_chnl_fail_pending(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs, u8 count)
307: {
308: 	mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
309: 	u8 i;
310: 
311: 	for (i = 0; i < count; i++)

315: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
316: 		failure.hdr.cmd = ((mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&logs[i].chnnl_tx_buff)->hdr.cmd;
317: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
318: 		logs[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
319: 		if (logs[i].tx_cmpl_isr)
320: 			logs[i].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[i].isr_param, &failure);

322: }

337: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
338: {
339: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
340: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
341: 	u16 			chnl_type;
342: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
343: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
344: 
345: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
346: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
347: 
348: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
349: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
350: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
351: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
352: #endif
353: 
354: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
355: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
356: 
357: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
358: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
359: 
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
361: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
362: 
363: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
364: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
365: 
366: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
367: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
368: 
369: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
370: 
371: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
372: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
373: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
374: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
375: 
376: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
377: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_cmd_header = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
378: 
379: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
380: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
381: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
382: 
383: 	__DMB();
384: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
385: 
386: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
387: 
388: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
389: 
390: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
391: 	{
392: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
393: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
394: 
395: 		return ret_code;
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
399: 
400: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
401: 
402: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
403: 	{
404: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
405: 	}
406: 
407: 	return BK_OK;
408: }

410: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
411: {
412: 	u8		log_chnl;
413: 	u8		ret_code;
414: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
415: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
416: 
417: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
418: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
419: 
420: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
421: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
422: 	{
423: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
424: 
425: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
426: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
427: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
428: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
429: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
430: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
431: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
432: 		{
433: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
434: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
435: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
436: 			return;
437: 		}
438: 
439: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
441: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
442: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
443: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
444: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
445: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
446: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
447: 		{
448: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
449: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
450: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
451: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
452: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
453: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
454: 			{
455: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
456: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
457: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
458: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
459: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
460: 			}
461: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
462: 		}
463: 		else
464: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
465: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
466: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
467: 		return;
468: 	}
469: 
470: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
471: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
472: 
473: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
474: 
475: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
476: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
477: 		return;
478: 	}
479: 
480: 
481: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
482: 	{
483: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
484: 		return;
485: 	}
486: 
487: 
488: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
489: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
490: 		return;
491: 	}
492: 
493: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
494: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_header = ack_ptr->hdr.data;
495: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_data1 = ack_ptr->data1;
496: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
497: 
498: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
499: 	{
500: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
501: 		return;
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
505: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
506: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
507: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
508: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
509: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
510: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
511: 	{
512: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
513: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
514: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
515: 		return;
516: 	}
517: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
518: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
519: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
520: 
521: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
522: 
523: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
524: 	{
525: 		/* clear following header members. */
526: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
527: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
528: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
529: 
530: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
531: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
532: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
533: 	} else {
534: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
535: 	}
536: 
537: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
538: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
539: 	{
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
544: 	{
545: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
546: 			break;
547: 	}
548: 
549: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
550: 	{
551: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
552: 		return;
553: 	}
554: 
555: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
556: 
557: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
558: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
559: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
560: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
561: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
562: 
563: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
564: 
565: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
566: 	{
567: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
568: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
569: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
570: 	}
571: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
572: 
573: 	return;
574:

577: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
578: {
579: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
580: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
581: 
582: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
583: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
584: 
585: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
586: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
587: 
588: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
589: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
590: 
591: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
592: 
593: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
594: 		return;
595: 
596: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
597: 		return;
598: 
599: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
600: 		return;
601: 
602: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
603: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
604: 
605: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
606: 
607: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
608: 	{
609: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
610: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
611: 
612: 		return;
613: 	}
614: 
615: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
616: 	{
617: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
618: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
619: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
620: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
621: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
622: 
623: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
624: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
625: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
626: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
627: 	}
628: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
629: 	{
630: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
631: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
632: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
633: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
634: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
635: 
636: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
637: 
638: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
643: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
644: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
645: 	}
646: 
647: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
648: 	{
649: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
650: 		return;
651: 	}
652: 
653: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
654: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
655: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
656: 
657: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
658: 	{
659: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
660: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
661: 		return;
662: 	}
663: 	return;
664: }

666: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
667: {
668: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
669: 
670: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
671: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
672: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
673: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
674: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
675: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
676: 
677: 	/*
678: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
679: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
680: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
681: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
682: 	 */
683: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
684: 	{
685: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
686: 	}
687: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
688: 	{
689: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
690: 	}
691: }

693: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
694: {
695: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
696: 
697: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
698: 
699: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
700: 
701: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
702: 
703: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
704: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
705: 
706: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
707: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
708: 
709: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
710: 
711: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
712: 	{
713: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
714: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
715: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
716: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
717: 
718: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
719: 
720: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
721: 		{
722: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
723: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
724: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
725: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
726: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
727: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
728: 
729: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
730: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
731: 			}
732: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
733: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
734: 			return ret_code;
735: 		}
736: 	}
737: 
738: 	return BK_OK;
739: }

802: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
803: {
804: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
805: 	int				i, j;
806: 
807: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
808: 
809: 	/*
810: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
811: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
812: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
813: 	 * can race here:
814: 	 *
815: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
816: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
817: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
818: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
819: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
820: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
821: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
822: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
823: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
824: 	 *
825: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
826: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
827: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
828: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
829: 	 */
830: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
831: 	{
832: 		return BK_OK;
833: 	}
834: 
835: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
836: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
837: 	{
838: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
839: 		return BK_OK;
840: 	}
841: 
842: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
843: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
844: 	ack_read = 0;
845: 	ack_write = 0;
846: 	ack_count = 0;
847: 	ack_sending = 0;
848: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
849: 	{
850: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
851: 
852: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
853: 
854: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
855: 
856: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
857: 		{
858: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
859: 		}
860: 	}
861: 
862: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
863: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
864: 	{
865: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
866: 		return ret_code;
867: 	}
868: 
869: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
870: 
871: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
872: 	{
873: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
874: 
875: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
876: 	}
877: 
878: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
879: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
880: 
881: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
882: 
883: 	return BK_OK;
884: }

33: 	u32 cmd_order[MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM];
34: 	u32 ack_order[MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM];
35: 	u32 reset_order;
36: 	u32 sync_order;
37: 	u32 fifo_empty_since_ms;
38: } mbox0_tx_slots_t;

40: typedef struct {
41: 	mailbox_data_t data;
42: 	u8 source;
43: 	u8 used;
44: 	u32 order;
45: } mbox0_rx_desc_t;

50: static mailbox_callback_t mailbox_callback[MBOX_CHNL_NUM];
51: static mbox0_rx_desc_t rx_desc[MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM];
52: static volatile u8 rx_count;
53: static u32 rx_order;
54: static mbox0_adapter_diag_t adapter_diag;

57: static void mbox0_reap_slots(u8 dst)
58: {
59: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64: 
65: 	if (mbox0_drv_get_send_count(dst, &fifo_count) != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
66: 		return;
67: 
68: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)
70: 	{
71: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* The hardware FIFO contains pointers into these slots.  Once it has
91: 	 * remained empty for the quarantine interval, the peer has had ample time
92: 	 * to copy every published entry.  ACK-only AP traffic has no later command
93: 	 * fence, so retaining these slots indefinitely exhausts the pool during
94: 	 * RESET/STATE/PWC bring-up.
95: 	 */
96: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
97: 	{
98: 		reaped += slots->ack_used[i] != 0;
99: 		slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
100: 	}
101: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
102: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
103: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
104: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
105: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
106: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
107: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
108: }

110: static bool mbox0_rx_ready(void)
111: {
112: 	return rx_count < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM;

115: static mbox0_rx_desc_t *mbox0_oldest_desc(bool priority)
116: {
117: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *oldest = NULL;
118: 	u8 i;
119: 
120: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
121: 	{
122: 		u8 ctrl;
123: 
124: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
125: 			continue;
126: 		ctrl = (rx_desc[i].data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
127: 		if (((ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0) != priority)
128: 			continue;
129: 		if (!oldest || (int32_t)(rx_desc[i].order - oldest->order) < 0)
130: 			oldest = &rx_desc[i];
131: 	}
132: 	return oldest;
133: }

135: static mbox0_stable_slot_t *mbox0_alloc_slot(u8 dst, u8 ctrl,
136: 					     u8 *kind, u8 *index)
137: {
138: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
139: 	u8 i;
140: 
141: 	if (ctrl == (MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX | MBOX0_CTRL_RESET))
142: 	{
143: 		if (slots->reset_used)
144: 			return NULL;
145: 		slots->reset_used = 1;
146: 		slots->reset_order = ++slots->publish_order;
147: 		*kind = 2;
148: 		return &slots->reset;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
152: 	{
153: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
154: 		{
155: 			if (!slots->ack_used[i])
156: 			{
157: 				slots->ack_used[i] = 1;
158: 				slots->ack_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
159: 				*kind = 1;
160: 				*index = i;
161: 				return &slots->ack[i];
162: 			}
163: 		}
164: 		return NULL;
165: 	}
166: 
167: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
168: 	{
169: 		if (slots->sync_used)
170: 			return NULL;
171: 		slots->sync_used = 1;
172: 		slots->sync_order = ++slots->publish_order;
173: 		*kind = 3;
174: 		return &slots->sync;
175: 	}
176: 
177: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
178: 	{
179: 		if (!slots->cmd_used[i])
180: 		{
181: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 1;
182: 			slots->cmd_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
183: 			slots->cmd_active = i + 1;
184: 			*kind = 0;
185: 			*index = i;
186: 			return &slots->cmd[i];
187: 		}
188: 	}
189: 
190: 	return NULL;
191: }

193: static void mbox0_release_slot(u8 dst, u8 kind, u8 index)
194: {
195: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
196: 
197: 	if (kind == 0)
198: 	{
199: 		slots->cmd_used[index] = 0;
200: 		if (slots->cmd_active == index + 1)
201: 			slots->cmd_active = 0;
202: 	}
203: 	else if (kind == 1)
204: 		slots->ack_used[index] = 0;
205: 	else if (kind == 2)
206: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
207: 	else
208: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
209: }

211: void bk_mailbox_poll(void)
212: {
213: 	u8 dst;
214: 
215: 	u32 flags = rtos_disable_int();
216: 	for (dst = 0; dst < MBOX_CHNL_NUM; dst++)
217: 	{
218: 		if (dst != MAILBOX_CPU0)
219: 			mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
220: 	}
221: 	mbox0_drv_poll();
222: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
223: 
224: 	while (1)
225: 	{
226: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t desc;
227: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t *selected;
228: 
229: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
230: 		if (!rx_count)
231: 		{
232: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
233: 			break;
234: 		}
235: 		selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(true);
236: 		if (!selected)
237: 			selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(false);
238: 		if (!selected ||
239: 			(((selected->data.param0 >> 12) & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 &&
240: 			 upper_rx_ready && !upper_rx_ready()))
241: 		{
242: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
243: 			break;
244: 		}
245: 		desc = *selected;
246: 		selected->used = 0;
247: 		rx_count--;
248: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
249: 		if (mailbox_callback[desc.source])
250: 			mailbox_callback[desc.source](&desc.data);
251: 
252: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
253: 		mbox0_drv_poll();
254: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
255: 	}
256: }

258: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
259: {
260: 	u32 address;
261: 	u32 source;
262: 	u32 reaped = 0;
263: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
264: 	u8 ctrl;
265: 	u8 i;
266: 
267: 	if (!msg)
268: 		return;
269: 
270: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
271: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
272: 	{
273: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
274: 		return;
275: 	}
276: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
277: 	{
278: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
279: 		return;
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	address = msg->data[0];
283: 	if (address & 0x3u)
284: 	{
285: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
286: 		return;
287: 	}
288: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
289: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
290: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
291: 	{
292: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
293: 		return;
294: 	}
295: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
296: 	{
297: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
302: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
303: #endif
304: 	__DMB();
305: 	desc = NULL;
306: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
307: 	{
308: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
309: 		{
310: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
311: 			break;
312: 		}
313: 	}
314: 	if (!desc)
315: 	{
316: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
317: 		return;
318: 	}
319: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
320: 	adapter_diag.last_rx_header = desc->data.param0;
321: 	ctrl = (desc->data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
322: 	if (ctrl == 0)
323: 	{
324: 		/* AP serializes ordinary logical commands.  Receiving the next one
325: 		 * proves that it copied the preceding CP transport ACK, providing an
326: 		 * exact lifetime fence even during a continuous UART/PWC burst. */
327: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
328: 		{
329: 			reaped += mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] != 0;
330: 			mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] = 0;
331: 		}
332: 		adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
333: 	}
334: 	desc->source = source;
335: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
336: 	desc->used = 1;
337: 	rx_count++;
338: 	adapter_diag.rx_accepted++;
339: 
340: }

372: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src,
373: 			 mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
374: {
375: 	mbox0_message_t message;
376: 	mbox0_stable_slot_t *slot;
377: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
378: 	u8 ctrl;
379: 	u8 kind = 0;
380: 	u8 index = 0;
381: 	int ret_code;
382: 
383: 	(void)arg;
384: 	if (src != MAILBOX_CPU0 || dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
385: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
386: 	if (!data)
387: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
388: 
389: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat(dst, &fifo_status);
390: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
391: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
392: 	if (fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL)
393: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
394: 
395: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
396: 	mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
397: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
398: 	if (!slot)
399: 	{
400: 		adapter_diag.tx_slot_busy++;
401: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
402: 	}
403: 
404: 	memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
405: 	memcpy(&slot->data, data, sizeof(slot->data));
406: 	mailbox_slots[dst].fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
407: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
408: 	SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((u32 *)slot, sizeof(*slot));
409: #endif
410: 	__DMB();
411: 	message.data[0] = (u32)&slot->data;
412: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(slot->data);
413: 	message.dest_cpu = dst;
414: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
415: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
416: 	{
417: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
418: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
419: 	}
420: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
421: 	{
422: 		adapter_diag.last_ack_header = slot->data.param0;
423: 		adapter_diag.ack_sent++;
424: 	}
425: 	return BK_OK;
426: }

428: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
429: {
430: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
431: 	u32 completed_order;
432: 	u8 i;
433: 
434: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
435: 		return;
436: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
437: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
438: 		return;
439: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
440: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
441: 	{
442: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
443: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
444: 	}
445: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
446: 	{
447: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
448: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
449: 	}
450: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
451: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
452: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
453: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
454: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
455: }

458: {
459: 	if (dst < MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
460: 		mailbox_slots[dst].cmd_active = 0;
461: }

353: /****************************************************************************
354:  * Name: mpu_log2regionceil
355:  *
356:  * Description:
357:  *   Determine the smallest value of l2size (log base 2 size) such that the
358:  *   following is true:
359:  *
360:  *   size <= (1 << l2size)
361:  *
362:  * Input Parameters:
363:  *   size - The size of the region.
364:  *
365:  * Returned Value:
366:  *   The logarithm base 2 of the ceiling value for the MPU region size.
367:  *
368:  ****************************************************************************/
369: 
370: uint8_t mpu_log2regionceil(size_t size)
371: {
372:   uint8_t l2size;
373: 
374:   /* The minimum permitted region size is 32 bytes (log2(32) = 5. */
375: 
376:   for (l2size = 5; l2size < 32 && size > (1 << l2size); l2size++);
377:   return l2size;

149: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
150: 		{
151: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
152: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
153: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
154: 		}
155: 		else
156: 		{
157: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
158: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
159: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
160: 			{
161: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
162: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
163: 				#endif
164: 				__DMB();
165: 				
166: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
167: 
168: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
169: 			}
170: 			else
171: 			{
172: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
173: 			}
174: 		}
175: 
176: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
177: 
178: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
179: 
180: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
181: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
182: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
183: 
184: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
185: 
186: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
187: 	}
188: 	else
189: 	{
190: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
191: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
192: 
193: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
194: 
195: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
196: 		{
197: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
198: 		}
199: 		else
200: 		{
201: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
202: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
203: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
204: 			{
205: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
206: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
207: 				#endif
208: 				__DMB();
209: 				
210: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
211: 
212: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
213: 			}
214: 			else
215: 			{
216: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
217: 			}
218: 
219: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
220: 		}
221: 
222: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
223: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
224: 	}

226: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
227: 
228: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
229: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
230: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
231: 	 */
232: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
233: 
234: 	return;
235:

238: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
239: {
240: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
241: 	{
242: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
243: 			return;
244: 
245: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
246: 
247: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) 
248: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
249: 		{
250: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
251: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
252: 
253: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
254: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
255: 		}
256: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
257: 		{
258: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
259: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
260: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
261: 
262: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
263: 
264: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
265: 
266: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
267: 			{
268: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
269: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
270: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
271: 			}
272: 			else
273: 			{
274: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
275: 				{
276: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
277: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
278: 					#endif
279: 					__DMB();
280: 
281: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
282: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
283: 				}
284: 				else
285: 				{
286: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
287: 				}
288: 			}
289: 			
290: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
291: 		}
292: 		else
293: 		{
294: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
295: 		}
296: 
297: 		return;
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	/*
301: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
302: 	 */
303: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
304: 
305: 	return;
306: 
307: }

361: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
362: {
363: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
364: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
365: 
366: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
367: 		ipc_init();
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
371: 		return BK_FAIL;
372: 
373: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
374: 
375: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
376: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
377: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
378: 
379: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
380: 
381: 	do
382: 	{
383: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
384: 		{
385: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
386: 			break;
387: 		}
388: 
389: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
390: 			cmd_len = 0;
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
393: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
394: 
395: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
396: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
397: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
398: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
399: 
400: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
401: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
402: 		{
403: 			break;
404: 		}
405: 
406: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
407: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
408: 		{
409: 			break;
410: 		}
411: 
412: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
413: 
414: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
415: 		{
416: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
417: 			break;
418: 		}
419: 
420: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
421: 		{
422: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
423: 			break;
424: 		}
425: 
426: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
427: 		{
428: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
429: 			break;
430: 		}
431: 
432: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
433: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
434: 
435: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
436: 
437: 	}while(0);
438: 
439: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
440: 
441: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
442: 
443: 	return ret_val;
444: 
445: }

309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {

318: 					}

320: 				}

323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */

344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;

357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */

376: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
377: {

406: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;

408: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
411: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
412: 
413: 		return;
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
417: 	{
418: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
419: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
420: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
421: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
422: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;

425: 
426: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
427: 	}
428: 	else
429: 	{
430: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
431: 	}

433: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
434: 	{
435: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
436: 		return;
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
440: 
441: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
442: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
443: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
444: 
445: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
446: 
447: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
448: 
449: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
450: 
451: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
452: 	{
453: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
454: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
455: 
456: 		return;
457: 	}
458: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
